The discussion’s survival of 15 months "following the first surgery" does not identify which surgery is the first (colonostomy or anterior resection).
The mechanism of the thrombosis is given as alternatives ("could have occurred through this vascular invasion, or CTCs may have been implanted").
The abstract says the elevated tumor marker levels occurred after an early normal period and gives no time; the case text places elevated markers during adjuvant chemotherapy.
